parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `StreamErrorAnalyticsTests.streamErrorIncludesSessionDuration` (line 98) and `StreamErrorAnalyticsTests.streamErrorIncludesReconnectAttemptCount` (line 156) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Although the two methods share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.733), they are distinct test cases exercising different observable properties of stream error analytics: session duration inclusion versus reconnect-attempt-count inclusion. Collapsing or extracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated behavioral assertions. Per the decision rules, any cluster where all participating records are test fixtures warrants no-action.
